blocks.html: Existing steam piping systems shall be in accordance with Sections 1211.3.1 through 1211.3.2. Upon the completion of a new high-pressure steam piping system and department approval of same, the rules relating to maintenance requirements and the keeping of records for existing high-pressure steam piping systems shall apply.
